key_insight: AlB₁₂–Al detonation coatings improved the wear resistance of steel 45, with AB70 showing stable friction and wear characteristics.
engineering_relevance: The AlB₁₂–Al system is a candidate for wear-resistant coatings on steel components operating under sliding friction.
method: Deposited AB70 (70 wt.% AlB₁₂–30 wt.% Al) and AB30 (30 wt.% AlB₁₂–70 wt.% Al) using DNEPR-5M.
Characterized coating thickness, hardness and microstructure.
Evaluated friction, wear and surface changes across sliding speeds and loads.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports coatings approximately 170–200 μm thick, AB70 friction coefficients of 0.21–0.38 and wear rates of 3.3–8.6 μm/km, with coated samples outperforming uncoated steel 45.
watch_item: Oxidative and adhesive-abrasive wear were observed, but the abstract does not specify the tested speed/load ranges or quantify the wear-resistance gain over uncoated steel.
paper_title: Structure and properties of AlB12-Al detonation coatings on steel 45
